description: This Java source file defines the class PolicyQuerySignalMapper, which extends AbstractQuerySignalMapper for handling PolicyQueryCommand commands. It is responsible for generating the topic path for policy query signals within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

classes.name: PolicyQuerySignalMapper
classes.description: A class extending AbstractQuerySignalMapper that maps policy query commands to protocol signals by constructing the appropriate topic path.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Overrides the method to provide the topic path builder for the given PolicyQueryCommand, generating a topic path specific to policies.
